title: Inline Hockey
intro: Built in 2001, the Inline Hockey Rink is equipped with boards and glass around the perimeter, player benches, penalty boxes, score box, and lights. This is a regulation size hockey rink measuring 75 feet wide and 165 feet long, covered with a sports tile engineered for perfect puck glide and grip for inline skates.

sections.markdown: The Inline Hockey Rink is open to all authorized DoD cardholders, family members, and their guests.

sections.heading: Required Gear
sections.markdown:
All protective equipment is required at all times, while using the rink.

- Adult Helmet – Minimum half shield required
- Elbow Pads
- Youth Helmet – Full shield or cage required
- Hockey Gloves
- Knee/Shin Guards
- Mouth Piece
- Sticks & Skates

sections.heading: Adult Pick-up Games
sections.markdown:
- Available year-round
- Must wear required gear to attend pickup games
- Times subject to change due to weather and league tournaments

sections.heading: Youth Pick-Up Games
sections.markdown:
- Available year-round
- Sundays at 3PM
- Times subject to change due to weather and league tournaments

sections.heading: Leagues
sections.markdown:
MCCS Sports hosts a spring and fall league with an average of 6-8 teams per league.

Leagues are open to authorized patrons 18 years of age or older, and out of high school.
